title: Create or remove the dangling docs/appcheck-enforcement.md reference in docs/coding-standards.md

evidence.quote: ...enforcement flips only after CI/device tokens are registered and metrics reviewed, recorded in `docs/appcheck-enforcement.md`.

why: docs/appcheck-enforcement.md does not exist anywhere in the repo — PV-6's enforcement-status process points at a record that was never created. Given the project's known App Check debug-token fragility (wipes regenerate the token and cause 403/permission-denied outages), the absence of any recorded enforcement-status process for a fragile, security-relevant subsystem is more than pure hygiene.
recommendation: Either create docs/appcheck-enforcement.md recording current App Check enforcement status, or remove the dangling pointer from PV-6 until the doc exists.
acceptance_criteria: docs/appcheck-enforcement.md exists, or coding-standards.md:349 no longer references it
